result.summary: The page is largely consistent, but the bottom tab bar appears visually broken: a dark horizontal system/gesture bar cuts across the central navigation icons, making the search and cart tabs look obscured and potentially harder to tap. Excluded per instructions are the right-edge clipped carousel item and the partially visible card at the bottom of the viewport.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar/gesture indicator overlaps the bottom navigation area across the search and cart icons, visually crossing them out and making the tab bar look broken.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom inset/safe-area padding so the app tab bar sits above the system gesture/navigation area, and ensure tab icons remain fully visible and tappable.

issues.description: The bottom navigation icons have weak differentiation between active and inactive states beyond color, and the overlapping dark bar further reduces icon legibility.
issues.suggestion: Keep clear active/inactive styling with sufficient contrast and labels or larger touch targets for each tab.
